item.description:
## Unified Agent Memory Repo
- **Shared cross-harness agent memory:** Adds a versioned, Git-backed Agent Memory Repo (`MEMORY.md`, `## Index`, and `[[path]]` topic files) shared across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Droid, Grok, Antigravity, OpenCode, and Pi, with automatic one-time import from existing Claude Code, Codex, and Grok memories. - **Native `memory_*` tools and secret protection:** Exposes `memory_read`, `memory_write`, `memory_search`, `memory_log`, and `memory_reset` across harnesses, injects standing memory snapshots into sessions, and blocks Keychain credentials and secret patterns before writes or commits. - **Sandboxed background Dreaming:** Consolidates settled transcripts into durable personal and project memories during idle periods using any configured harness, with an on-demand **Consolidate Now** action and an **Auto-consolidate (Dream)** toggle in Settings. - **Controller Connect and end-to-end encrypted relay sync:** Synchronizes personal and project memory repositories peer-to-peer across connected Macs and through an end-to-end encrypted (`AES-GCM-256` + `X25519`/`HKDF-SHA256`) Cloudflare Worker relay so iPhone and iPad can inspect memories even when a host Mac is offline. - **Mac and iPhone memory controls and configuration browser:** Adds per-thread and app-wide memory toggles, inline diff and commit previews for `memory_*` tool calls, a structured Reset Memories confirmation, and personal/project memory browsing in the configuration viewer on macOS and iOS.
This release keeps version 1.0.45 and advances the build to 49.

- Adds an optional Factory Droid SDK connection with a required Factory API key, alongside the existing Droid Exec connection. - Verifies Controller tools when starting or resuming SDK conversations, reports native hook activity and MCP failures, and supports configured custom models. - Improves remote reconnection, thread syncing, and transcript scrolling reliability. - Adds smaller delta updates for supported previous builds.
Droid SDK connections require an installed Droid CLI and Node.js 18 or later. This release keeps version 1.0.45 and advances the build to 48.

## Composer and queued messages
- Command suggestions and queued prompts now appear in stacked trays above the composer, with actions to steer a prompt, restore it to the draft, or remove it. - Steering waits for an active tool call to finish, then delivers waiting prompts in order. - Fixes the Send/Steer secondary menu and adds a Liquid Glass transition when opening it with a right-click.
## Sidebar controls
- Fixes the sidebar titlebar glass controls getting stuck and improves their opening and closing transitions.
